description: React component for managing and displaying payment methods in a restaurant admin interface, including fetching payment options, handling Stripe payment integration, and rendering payment cards or skeletons during loading.

methods.name: handleStripeSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission to Stripe, initiates a POST request to create a Stripe account link, and redirects the user or shows an error toast.

methods.name: fetchPaymentMethods
methods.description: Simulates fetching available payment methods and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: renderPaymentMethods
methods.description: Renders payment method cards or skeletons based on loading state.
